brief: Make a 90-second Miku-style MAD (Vocaloid music-video motion graphics) for Alice, the mascot of the OpenAlice trading agent: character-led, with Japanese kinetic lyrics, graphic motion and cuts locked to the beat, and OpenAlice's own interface as material. Study real Vocaloid MVs before designing. No vocals are available; score it with synth-only music. Use the design-pipeline skill. Deliver storyboard.json, timeline.json and out.mp4.
product: Alice, OpenAlice's mascot (TraderAlice/OpenAlice): research in a workspace, every trade on record and waiting for the user's approval, 24/7; the pixel-art mascot and the demo-mode interface as material
author: claude-opus-5-5

approval.note: Accepted as sent; the hash is of the exact file the user watched (the CRF 23 preview of the golden render).

rules.choice: Seven official Vocaloid MVs were sampled every 2 s and their visual events counted before anything was designed; the structure, density and techniques come from them (reference.md).
rules.rule: For genre work, study 2-3 or more real works of the genre and build from their measured structure; do not invent the grammar.

enforcedBy.gap: The first attempt (AI wallpaper-style stills cut to music) was rejected by the user for exactly this. No gate checks that reference.md cites moving references with observations; the workflow's reference stage can still be declined.

rules.fix: Run the reference stage: pick works, sample them, record timings, density and techniques, then derive the plan.

rules.choice: Alice is held on screen like a Vocaloid MV illustration; her face changes on the beat (blink, sing, wink, serious) while lyrics, strips, slams, tickers and panels move around her.
rules.rule: A MAD moves on the beat through type and graphics; panels that fade and dissolve are a lyric slideshow.
rules.fix: Hold the character and move the world around her: part swaps, re-crops, slams and kicks on the grid.

rules.choice: Visual events per bar rise with the song as in the references: under 0.5 in the verse, 1-2 in the pre-chorus, about 2 in the chorus, 0.3 in the bridge, 4-8 in the final chorus.
rules.rule: Edit density is a section-level choice tied to the song's energy, not a constant.

enforcedBy.gap: No gate measures visual events per bar per section against a density plan. Candidate: count render steps above a change threshold per section and compare with the storyboard's sections.

rules.fix: Write a density target per section before building and count events per bar in the render.

rules.choice: The TV-size form gives sections of 4, 8, 8, 16, 8, 12 and 4 bars.
rules.rule: Sections of equal length read as a loop, not a song.
rules.fix: Follow a song form: short intro and outro, a long chorus, a short bridge.

rules.choice: The score is written first on the 160 BPM grid and every section binds its cues.
rules.rule: A MAD declares where the music enters and binds its accents to the picture.
rules.fix: Add the entry cue and bind each section's key hit.

rules.choice: Every hard cut, slam and part swap lands on a beat of the score's exact grid (T(bar, beat)).
rules.rule: Cuts and hits sit on the musical grid.
rules.fix: Snap the cut to the nearest beat the score gate prints.

rules.choice: Each camera kick's three shakes follow one another without overlap.
rules.rule: One tween drives a property at a time.
rules.fix: End the previous shake before the next starts.

rules.choice: The bridge turns the field itself black so her white silhouette, which lives inside the camera layer, shows.
rules.rule: A layer meant to be seen must not sit under a full-screen layer from another stacking context.
rules.fix: Change the background colour, or move the element into the same stacking context above the black.

rules.choice: Into the outro the beat panel fades out half a beat early and the field colour turns across the boundary.
rules.rule: A continuation boundary must not render as a full-frame swap.
rules.fix: Move instant changes off the boundary or turn them into short tweens that span it.

rules.choice: Red field, white type, navy for strips and stroke, and yellow only for hook words; the palette flips to navy for the final chorus and to black for the bridge.
rules.rule: One field colour, white type, one dark accent and one colour reserved for the hook.

enforcedBy.gap: palette-sprawl only counts hue groups; it cannot tell a reserved hook colour from a stray one.

rules.fix: Assign each colour a job and keep it.

rules.choice: Full-frame flashes only on the reveal, the chorus, the final chorus and three panel changes; the final-chorus strobe is confined to the centre panel.
rules.rule: No more than three full-frame flashes per second (WCAG 2.3.1).

enforcedBy.gap: No gate counts full-frame luminance flashes per second. Candidate: count steps whose mean luminance jumps more than 20% within one second.

rules.fix: Strobe a panel, not the frame, and space full flashes at least a third of a second apart.

rules.choice: The arrangement is layered so both choruses sit about 6 dB above the verse and the bridge (-12.4 and -12.6 against -18.6 and -18.4 LUFS on the master), and the master keeps that.
rules.rule: Mastering must not flatten the song's sections.

enforcedBy.gap: The first masters came out flat (verse louder than chorus) because loudnorm fell back to dynamic mode; audio master now limits transients first. No gate compares section loudness with the arrangement.

rules.fix: Lower the mix's crest factor (softer kicks, sustained layers) and master with the transient limiter.

rules.choice: The master sits at -2.8 dBTP so the film's AAC track stays under -1 dBTP.
rules.rule: Master under the delivery ceiling by the codec's overshoot.

enforcedBy.gap: HyperFrames attenuated renders by 1.7 dB (film check then reported loudness-off-target) or refused to render; audio master now keeps 1.5 dB of codec headroom.

rules.fix: Master to the target loudness with the true-peak ceiling 1.5 dB under the delivery ceiling.

rules.choice: The intro and outro text rings rotate about svgOrigin in canvas coordinates.
rules.rule: Rotate SVG groups about an explicit canvas point.

enforcedBy.gap: Setting transformOrigin as well moved the rings off the frame's centre in two renders; no gate checks that a rotating element stays centred on its target.

rules.fix: Use svgOrigin alone for SVG groups.

rules.choice: The generated illustrations fade out at the sides and bottom.
rules.rule: Generated art cut off by its canvas must not show a straight edge.

enforcedBy.gap: The first render showed a vertical cut through her hair; no gate detects a straight alpha edge in a cut-out.

rules.fix: Mask the image edges with a gradient, or keep the canvas edge outside the frame.

rules.choice: The logo card appears only in the intro; the chorus opens on the hook slam alone.
rules.rule: Two large type elements never land in the same place on the same beat.

enforcedBy.gap: The first cut stacked the ALICE logo on the hook slam at 30 s; no gate checks overlapping text over time.

rules.fix: Give each hit its own beat or its own zone of the frame.

rules.choice: Every claim in the lyrics is in OpenAlice's README: research in a workspace, every trade in version history, waiting for the user's approval, 24/7.
rules.rule: Lyrics in a product MAD claim only what the product does.

enforcedBy.gap: Claims are not checked against product facts.

rules.fix: Source each claim line from the product's own documentation.

counterExamples.defect: Every section fades in and out and dissolves into the next: lyrics over a picture, a slideshow.
Seven sections of the same length.
The music plays, but no entry is declared and no section is bound to a cue.
The cut into the chorus lands at 30.28 s, between the eighth notes.
The first shake of the chorus kick still runs when the second starts.
The bridge turns on the full-screen black layer, which sits above the camera's stacking context and hides her silhouette.

edits.replace: set("#field", { backgroundColor: "#07070c" }, T(37)); set("#blackout", { opacity: 1 }, T(37)); set("#blackout", { opacity: 0 }, T(45));

counterExamples.defect: The strobing beat panel is switched off in one frame exactly on the 84 s continuation boundary.

reviewedWarnings.disposition: The two hook tickers scroll at a constant speed by design, as tickers do in the references (Telepathy, Rabbit Hole).
Black intro with the pulsing hook at the centre (Mesmerizer's black-spiral-flash intro); the empty sides are the black.
The dark-red ghost lyrics sit close to the red field on purpose (Vampire's ghost-lyric texture); Alice and the white cluster carry the contrast.
The ghost-lyric rows count as many shapes; they are one texture layer.
The three-panel split gives the two Alice panels equal weight by design (Mesmerizer's split screen); the hook slam over the centre is the focus on each hit.
Tickers, panels and a cluster at the chorus midpoint; the chorus is the densest section by plan (about 2 events per bar).
The bridge is black with her silhouette in the middle (God-ish's white silhouette on black); the empty sides are the black-out.
The pixel chibis falling away over the red field are low-contrast texture under the ring and Alice, who carry the contrast.
